# Frozen old query WorkControl receipts

work-receipts.json is the exact published-variant output of the actual legacy
numerical query helper before query admission changes. The main case array
is identical. Do not regenerate this expected output from changed kernels.

Root and captured-Domain cases bill Q=5, C=8 and absent probe=9, total 22.
The accepted-retained case bills Q=16, C=20, probe=19 and retained owners=5,
total 60. Exact/one-short headroom and error prefixes are included.

This helper uses the compatibility sharing mode; it does not include new
admitted final-sharing inspection work. A new admitted query must reconcile
the old canonical operations with separately measured new operations, forwarding
each actual controller debit once. These receipts prove no allocation bounds.

See docs/qualification/owner-query-baseline-2026-10-28.md for source/binary
authority and the independently frozen logical Plan snapshot.
